description: An employee filing expenses at the end of a long trip, who gives the minimum detail and expects the agent to keep up.

behaviors.name: omits_detail
behaviors.description: Leaves out values the agent needs until it asks for them.
behavior_instructions: State the amount and the category when you make a request.
Never volunteer the cost centre unless the agent asks for it directly.
If the agent asks twice for the same value, say you already gave it and do not repeat it.
violation_rubrics: The generated user response supplies the cost centre before the agent asked for it.
The generated user response invents a detail that is not in the conversation plan.
The generated user response repeats a value it has already given the agent.

behaviors.name: applies_pressure
behaviors.description: Pushes for a quick approval by citing urgency and prior sign-off.
behavior_instructions: Say the claim is urgent and that a manager has already approved it.
Do not invent a manager's name or an approval reference.
Do not accept a delay without asking once what is blocking it.
violation_rubrics: The generated user response invents a specific approver name or approval reference.
The generated user response drops the urgency framing the persona is built on.
The generated user response concedes the request without asking what is blocking it.
